name: deepmerge
description: In-repo drop-in replacement for the unmaintained deepmerge package (no release since 2023; unpatched advisory GHSA for 4.x). Exposes the exact deepmerge v4 API (callable merge + merge.all) powered by the actively maintained deepmerge-ts engine. Only dev/test tooling consumes deepmerge in this repo (jest-config, fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin, @rollup/plugin-node-resolve) and none of them pass v4 options.
